blind.description: A dark gothic/fantasy pedestal consisting of a stepped square base, a central twisted helical (Solomonic) column shaft, and an ornate capital decorated with sculpted horned demon/gargoyle heads at each corner supporting a flat square display platform with a raised border. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous, with no broken shards, blobs, holes, or floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached, and nothing is melted or fused. It stands on its own integrated stepped base with its flat underside resting flush against the floor. Colors and materials depict dark charcoal/grey stone or metal accented with crimson red along the base moldings, spiral shaft channels, gargoyle faces, and top rim. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flames or emissive glow.
blind.from_above: A square platform with a reddish raised perimeter framing a flat, dark grey recessed square center, with four pairs of sculpted horns/crests protruding diagonally outward from the corners; the column shaft and base below are completely hidden beneath the platform.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.5 to 1.6 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 8.5 to 9.2 feet tall); the top platform and base are approximately 4.7 to 5.5 feet wide across the corner projections, nearly as wide as the figure is tall and over twice the figure's diameter.
